title: get_dependencies does not behave as expected with eqx_module
author: rayisaacalan

comments.author: rayisaacalan
comments.body:
This appears to be related to #2064 (same behavior with both get_dependencies and get_model_relations) due to how eqx_module defines its parameters with a lambda callable:

https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/blob/fb14da77654035cefd438c86062c24db8eb3befe/numpyro/contrib/module.py#L616

rather than a literal value like in the nnx_module:

https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/blob/fb14da77654035cefd438c86062c24db8eb3befe/numpyro/contrib/module.py#L481

comments.author: juanitorduz
comments.body: Thanks! I submitted a patch in https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/pull/2078
